veg_ledger.nutrient_source: Authored within cited ranges. Frank and McNaughton 1993 Oecologia 96, 157-161 doi:10.1007/BF00317727 (promotion of grassland production by grazers); Frank, Inouye, Huntly, Minshall, Anderson 1994 Biogeochemistry 26, 163-188 doi:10.1007/BF02182072 (N flow 8.1 to 45.6 kg/ha/yr, mean 27.0, in Yellowstone grazed range).
veg_ledger.sinter_source: Authored within NPS Yellowstone Cistern Spring observation of up to 12 mm/yr sinter deposition versus 12 to 25 mm/century at typical features (NPS visitor material). Thinning magnitude per unit trampling fraction is authored.
veg_ledger.trampling_source: Authored. Direction and order of magnitude supported by the ecosystem-management ungulate literature; specific tau values are authored. Weisberg, Hobbs, Ellis, Coughenour 2002 J. Env. Manage. 65, 181-197 doi:10.1006/jema.2002.0552.
